title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
About us
Noor Digital builds booking and payments products for hospitality brands across the GCC. Our web apps serve over two million users a month in English and Arabic.

The role
We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to lead the build of our next-generation booking platform, working closely with product designers and backend engineers.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain customer-facing web apps in React and TypeScript
- Own performance, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and Core Web Vitals for key flows
- Implement responsive, bilingual (LTR/RTL) interfaces from Figma designs
- Contribute to and maintain our component library / design system
- Review code and mentor two mid-level developers
- Work with backend teams on REST and GraphQL APIs

Must have
- 5+ years of professional frontend development
- Strong React and TypeScript; experience with Next.js
- Solid HTML, CSS (Tailwind or CSS-in-JS) and responsive design
- Testing experience (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress or Playwright)
- Git, CI/CD, and working in agile teams
- Fluent English

Nice to have
- Arabic language skills or RTL interface experience
- Design systems / Storybook
- Motion and animation (Framer Motion, GSAP)
- Payments or booking domain experience
- Based in the UAE or willing to relocate

What we offer
Salary range AED 28,000 - 35,000 per month, annual flight, health insurance for family, and a learning budget.
stageContext: Established product serving two million users a month.
whatTheyOwnFirst: Lead the build of the next-generation booking platform.
